description_en: Invokes ListRoomUsers to query the real-time user list in a room by paging
description_zh: 调用ListRoomUsers分页查询房间内的实时用户列表
name: ListRoomUsers

parameters.help_en: The application ID of the user, generated when the application is created in the console. The ID contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The page number to query, starting from 1. If this parameter is left empty, the first page is queried by default
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，从1开始，传空默认查询第1页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. If this parameter is left empty, the default value is 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示个数，最大支持100，参数为空默认显示个数为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The room ID, consisting of letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.). Maximum length: 36 characters
parameters.help_zh: 房间ID，由字母、数字、下划线（_）和小数点（.）组成，最大长度36个字符
parameters.name: room_id
